annotations.title: Change how my page appears in search

description: Set the title (up to 60 characters) and description (up to 160) in the page's HTML head, which search engines and link previews read. Part of Premium. A blank value goes back to the text Kulhad generates. This does not set an image and does not contact any search engine; it only changes what the page serves.
